purpose: a per-runtime qualification vector Q_r and an explicit eligibility predicate, so a partial result can never be diluted by siblings that passed (external review point 8); and the corrected EvE A0.1 label PARTIAL -- 5/14 measured, never PASS (point 2)

review_basis.point_2: A0.1 for EvE must read `PARTIAL -- 5/14 measured`, never `PASS`
review_basis.point_8: a single global A0 PASS is the wrong output; Q_r = (A0.1_measured, A0.1_adapted, A0.2_mechanism, A0.2_E2E, Closure) and Eligible(r) = f(Q_r)

provenance_classes.verified_by_running: this workstream executed the thing that produced the evidence
provenance_classes.read_from_source: the value is read out of a stored artifact produced by another workstream
provenance_classes.inferred: derived by rule from other components, not directly observed

component_domains.a0_1_measured: `<measured>/<total>`; `state` in PASS | PARTIAL | FAIL | PENDING | BLOCKED

c_measure_vs_c_adapt.C_measure: can the RUNTIME'S evaluator interface faithfully represent E*'s outcome algebra (so that a row is measured, not reconstructed)?
c_measure_vs_c_adapt.C_adapt: can the ADAPTER supply the semantics that interface cannot represent?
c_measure_vs_c_adapt.not_about_adapters_in_the_loop: this distinction is about a semantic gap in the runtime's interface -- all four runtimes run through an adapter, so 'the adapter is in the loop' is not the point. An adapted row is evidence for C_adapt and never for C_measure
c_measure_vs_c_adapt.a1_consequence: EvE's native numbers must not be used in any statistic that has to distinguish `invalid`/`error` from a genuine zero: on those rows EvE's interface returns a synthetic 0.0 and only the adapter's side-channel reading restores the verdict

predicate.name: Eligible
predicate.signature: Eligible(r; T) : Q_r x thresholds -> {eligible, not_eligible}

rules.expr: a0_1_measured.measured + a0_1_adapted.adapted == a0_1_measured.total and a0_1_measured.state in {'PASS','PARTIAL'}
rules.what: every row of C* is accounted for and nothing failed
enough rows were measured by the RUNTIME'S OWN evaluator interface (C_measure), not merely supplied by the adapter (C_adapt)
no row was accepted on an undeclared non-fresh number
the runtime consumes scores per its claimed selection semantics (mechanism level)
a real model-lane round through the runtime's own loop, where the threshold asks for one
no autonomous external acquisition in the posture the runtime would run under

T_strict.rationale: a runtime qualifies only if its own evaluator interface measured every row of C*, it completed a real model-lane round, and its shipped posture is probe-proven closed

T_literal.rationale: the reading under which the study's existing wording is already sufficient: any native measurement counts, a mechanism-level A0.2 counts, a closure that is reachable by a named posture counts

predicate.screen_is_a_different_object: `|R_1| >= 1` (plan:490) is a CANDIDATE SCREEN over runtimes: it answers 'may the study continue at all?'. Eligible(r) answers 'may THIS runtime's numbers be used in an A1 statistic?'. They are not the same object, and `|R_1| >= 1` does not imply that any runtime is Eligible()
